method: Ran twelve offline assertions. The verifier compiles Python examples, executes the parser against constructed full-object/suffix/duplicate-key fixtures, injects a fake Anthropic SDK response, and checks numeric answer parsing, separate usage fields, line width, and fail-closed branches. No provider call was made. The 419-page production build and Pagefind index were checked; light/dark full-page renders were measured at 1300px viewport width.
limitations: The historical CoT requests/responses, exact model fingerprint, complete usage, item-level task set, and scorer are unavailable; the historical accuracy and token summaries were not reproduced.
The conflicting prefill values temp_c=20 and temp_c=null cannot be resolved without the raw response.
The local mocks do not validate any current Anthropic request, endpoint compatibility, model quality, cost, latency, or general CoT effect.
The cited CoT paper uses its own few-shot demonstrations and benchmark/model setup; the current example is a separate evaluation harness.

The current official Anthropic documentation was checked on 2026-10-22 for usage totals and model-specific prefill support; this does not verify the endpoint behavior of the historical DeepSeek-compatible service.
The initial visual run logs the existing favicon.ico 404; this lesson change did not introduce it.
